verdict.rationale: LobeHub's own changelog says the Home dashboard shows a daily brief and suggestions alongside what your agents did while you were away. Onboarding also suggests concrete starter Tasks based on what you tell it about your work. These are direct, first-party features, but the docs are a few changelog lines and don't explain how the insights are derived from your data. Missing for 10: documentation of what user data the brief and suggestions analyze, depth of insight generation (trends, analytics over your content), any dedicated usage docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: See what your Agents did while you were away. Home is now a dashboard: a greeting and composer on one side, and a rail of cards on the other showing what needs you, what is still running, your daily brief, and suggestions.
Onboarding now suggests concrete first Tasks based on what you tell it about your work, instead of leaving you with an empty screen.
It hires, schedules, reports on your entire AI team.
